findings.text: The document assumes that both `BETWEEN` comparisons use only `x`'s affinity and collation, but [SQLite applies each comparison's rules separately](https://sqlite.org/datatype3.html#type_conversions_prior_to_comparison), including the right operand's affinity and explicit collation. Fix: specify the rules of `x >= a AND x <= b`, with `x` evaluated once.

The new measurement script has no test that checks its feature classification and coverage counts. Fix: add a deterministic test with small case records and verdicts that checks foreign-key pragma classification and the resulting counts.
